cities.name: Frostwatch Landing
cities.blurb: A frontier survey outpost bolted to the ice: a landing pad, a cluster of prefab habs linked by heated walkways, and just enough trade to keep the lights on. Nobody owns it. Whatever is here answers to itself.

locations.name: The Frostwatch Tab
locations.blurb: The only warm room on the moon that will sell you a drink. Everyone passes through eventually.
locations.gmNotes: Quest hook: 'The Frostwatch Tab' — a departed spacer's unpaid bill.

interior.artSubject: a frontier cantina on a frozen ice moon

chatter: …and then the rings just ate the whole signal. Gone.
Don't touch the ice near Pad Two. Don't.
You're new. You'll be cold for a week, then you won't notice.
Whoever's broadcasting out there, they've been at it a long while.

npcs.name: Sallis Kord

dossier.stats: AC 11 · HP 30 · Insight +4 · knows everyone on the moon by name
dossier.look: Broad, unhurried, two fingers missing from the pouring hand. Never sits down.
dossier.personality: Reads a stranger before they reach the counter and prices them accordingly. Genuinely likes people; will still take your money.
dossier.voice: Slow, warm, and entirely unbothered. Long pauses you will want to fill.

npcs.blurb: Broad, unhurried, and missing two fingers on the pouring hand. Has run the Tab for eleven years and can price a stranger before they reach the counter.
talkingPoints: You'll be the ones who came down hard on the north flats. Heard your engines from here.
Fuel's at the pad. Ilsa's at the hab. Anything else, you talk to me.
There's a tab on my board nobody's paid. Man shipped out and left it. I'd take it kindly if somebody settled it.
rumours: Something out on the ice has been transmitting since before I got here. Nobody's ever gone to look twice.
There's people living in the glacier east of here. They come in once a season, buy filters, say nothing.
The administrator's reactor is browning out. She won't say it, but she's frightened.

quests.summary: Every rumour on this moon says the same name: Wrenn Sallow, a surveyor at Sett who charted the whole Erevos Reach and never sold the chart. Sallis knows how to get an introduction.
quests.opening: You are asking the wrong question. You do not want a map of this moon. You want Wrenn Sallow, out at Sett, and you want to arrive owing them nothing.

reward.note: The complete Erevos Reach chart — every region named on the Map.

npcs.name: Merrow Vane
npcs.blurb: Three drinks past sensible and delighted to see new faces. Was a good surveyor once.

dossier.look: Weathered, red-nosed, wearing a survey coat two grades better than he can afford now.
dossier.personality: Warm, over-familiar, and genuinely brilliant for about ninety seconds at a time.
dossier.voice: Loud, then suddenly very quiet and precise when the subject turns to the ice.

talkingPoints: I mapped this moon before there was a pad on it. Ask me anything.
The rings eat signals. That's not weather. That's something sitting in them.
rumours: There's a hollow under the Bonefield. I've heard it breathe.

npcs.name: Sub-Commander Ferren Ost
npcs.blurb: Directorate uniform under a civilian coat, drinking alone and making no secret of either.

dossier.look: Rigid posture, grey at the temples, a Directorate sunburst worn where it can be seen.
dossier.personality: Courteous, direct, and entirely uninterested in whether you like the Directorate. Treats a mercenary contract as the honest transaction it is.
dossier.voice: Clipped, formal, no wasted words. Says 'thank you' like a closing statement.

talkingPoints: The Directorate does not have jurisdiction here. That is precisely why I am asking you.
There is an Apostle vessel using this volume as a censer route. I want it stopped.
You will be paid in Directorate scrip, honoured at any Frostwatch trade post.
rumours: The Apostles rig their hulls to burn. Boarding one is a way to die twice.

quests.summary: An Apostles of the Threshold cutter, the Censer, is using the Vorrn volume as a burn route and taking ships off it. The Directorate has no jurisdiction here, which is exactly why Ost is hiring outsiders to do it.
quests.opening: You have a ship with guns and no flag. I have a target and no jurisdiction. I would call that a productive misunderstanding, Captain.

reward.note: Directorate scrip, honoured at any Frostwatch post.

locations.name: The Trade Post
locations.blurb: Ration crates, patch kits, filament, and whatever the last ship couldn't sell elsewhere.

interior.artSubject: a frontier trading post on a frozen ice moon

chatter: Filters are up again. Everything's up.
If it isn't on the shelf, it isn't on the moon.

npcs.name: Otta Brill
npcs.blurb: Small, brisk, and entirely unimpressed by anyone's story. Prices are the prices.
talkingPoints: Shelf price is shelf price. You want a discount, bring me something I can sell.
Water filters, three left. After that you drink what the ice gives you.
rumours: The glacier folk buy filters by the crate. Somebody out there has a lot of mouths.

npcs.name: Pell Ashgrove
npcs.blurb: Buys cargo space nobody has sold yet and somehow always delivers.

dossier.look: Small, immaculate in a place where nobody is, gloves that have never touched cargo.
dossier.personality: Relentlessly cheerful and quietly ruthless. Will find you a berth and a reason to owe him.
dossier.voice: Fast, friendly, faintly nasal. Talks in shipping terms even about the weather.

talkingPoints: Everything on this moon moves through three people. I am two of them.
You have a hold. I have clients. This is the beginning of something.
rumours: A Directorate officer has been buying passage manifests. Not cargo. Manifests.

npcs.name: Sable Innes
npcs.blurb: Runs the surface routes between the outpost and the Hollow on a patched-up crawler.

dossier.look: Windburned, goggle-tanned, thermal layers gone shiny at the elbows.
dossier.personality: Blunt and unsentimental about distance, weather and the odds. Likes anyone who can read ice.
dossier.voice: Flat, quick, with the clipped cadence of somebody used to a bad comm channel.

talkingPoints: Kettle Hollow will not open the gate for you. They open it for me.
Route's four hours if the wind holds. Eleven if it doesn't. Pack accordingly.
rumours: The Hollow's people stopped digging below the hall. Nobody there will tell me why.

locations.name: The Bonefield
locations.blurb: A fenced acre of frozen wreckage. Pay the yardmaster and pick the bones.

interior.artSubject: a fenced salvage yard of frozen ship wreckage, open to the sky

chatter: Mind the edges. Everything out here is edges.
That hull's been here longer than the outpost.

npcs.name: Kesh Duval

dossier.stats: AC 14 · HP 45 · Str +3 · Athletics +5, cutting rig counts as a martial weapon
dossier.look: Three coats and a welding rig, goggles pushed up on a scarred forehead.
dossier.personality: Straight dealer, no small talk, quietly proud of the yard. Knows the provenance of every plate in it and will tell you at length.
dossier.voice: Flat and practical. Says the price once.

npcs.blurb: Wrapped in three coats and a welding rig. Knows the provenance of every plate in the yard.
talkingPoints: Pick rights are by the hour. Cut what you like, I weigh it on the way out.
Anything with a Concord stamp, you bring to me first. That's the deal.
rumours: I've a piece in the back I can't identify. Not Concord. Not anything.
Ilsa's missing rover — I'd look east, and I'd take a gun.

quests.summary: A hull section finally went through the ice at the back of the yard and opened a void underneath it. Kesh sent two cutters down. Neither came back and he has stopped sending people.
quests.opening: You want salvage rights? Fine. There is a hole at the back of my yard and two of my people are in it. Bring them up — or bring up what is left — and the yard is open to you.

reward.note: Free run of the Bonefield, and Torrin will cut anything you drag out.

npcs.name: Torrin Vey
npcs.blurb: Cuts hulls apart for a living and has the scars to show for the ones that fought back.

dossier.look: Enormous, soot-black to the elbows, welding rig slung permanently over one shoulder.
dossier.personality: Slow to speak, impossible to rush, and unexpectedly gentle with anyone new to the yard.
dossier.voice: Deep, unhurried, with long gaps you should not fill.

talkingPoints: Two of ours went into the underhang. Neither came back up.
I'll cut anything you like. I won't go below the fence line again.
rumours: The wrecks nearest the hole have been stripped from the inside.

npcs.name: Mave Okonu
npcs.blurb: Can price a hull plate at a glance and will tell you exactly how she got the number.

dossier.look: Sharp-eyed, coat covered in chalk marks, a loupe on a cord around her neck.
dossier.personality: Precise, dry, allergic to exaggeration. Respects anyone who shows their working.
dossier.voice: Measured and a little amused, like everything is slightly beneath her but not you personally.

talkingPoints: Ferrocrystal, verdite, Concord alloy. I can tell them apart in the dark. Usually am.
Kesh pays by the tonne. I price by the truth. We argue.
rumours: Something in the underhang is not wreckage. The assay comes back wrong.

locations.name: Administrator's Hab
locations.blurb: The outpost's office, its records, and the moon's only quest board.

interior.artSubject: the administrative hab of a frontier outpost

npcs.name: Ilsa Varn
npcs.blurb: Runs Frostwatch Landing on paperwork, stubbornness and a fusion tap that keeps browning out.

dossier.look: Tired, upright, a coat she never takes off indoors because the hab is never warm enough.
dossier.personality: Fair, overworked, and entirely out of patience for anyone who makes her day longer. Will deal straight with you if you deal straight with her.
dossier.voice: Even and dry, with the flatness of somebody who has said the same thing many times.

talkingPoints: Nobody owns this outpost. That means nobody fixes it either. That is where you come in.
There is a wreck out on the ice broadcasting the same six seconds. It predates all of us.
I can pay, or I can owe you. Owing me is worth more here than coin.
rumours: The beacon out on the ice changed pattern last week. Only once. Only I noticed.

quests.summary: A hauler went down on the ice north of the pads before Frostwatch existed and has been repeating the same six seconds ever since. Ilsa wants it shut up, and wants to know what it is before the Frostwatch decide it is their business.
quests.opening: Sit down. There is a wreck four hours north that has been talking to nobody since before I got here. Last week it changed. Once. I would like to know why.

reward.note: Outpost goodwill, and Ilsa owes you one — which is worth more here.

npcs.name: Doss Carrow
npcs.blurb: Keeps forty years of outpost records in his head because the terminal keeps failing.

dossier.look: Thin, ink-stained, half-moon lenses, a scarf indoors.
dossier.personality: Fussy, proud of the archive, and desperate for someone to be interested in it.
dossier.voice: Quick and reedy, prone to tangents he apologises for and then continues.

talkingPoints: Every ship that has ever landed here is in this room. On paper. I did that.
You want the wreck? I have the original distress log. Nobody has asked in nine years.
rumours: There is no registry entry for Kettle Hollow. There never has been.

npcs.name: Hela Brant
npcs.blurb: The Frostwatch's presence at the outpost, and deeply unconvinced by anything rift-touched.

dossier.look: Grey patrol armour, helmet under one arm, a stare she uses instead of questions.
dossier.personality: Suspicious by trade rather than temperament. Correct, never warm, and absolutely reliable.
dossier.voice: Level, unhurried, the tone of somebody who has already decided and is being polite about it.

talkingPoints: You came out of a rift. That is on your file now. It will stay there.
Cause trouble on my ice and I will not care where you are from.
rumours: The Directorate officer in the Tab has no business here. I have asked. He has answers.

locations.name: The Warmroom
locations.blurb: Two beds, a printer, and a medtech who has seen every kind of cold injury there is.

npcs.name: Corrin Ash
npcs.blurb: Calm to the point of unnerving. Treats everyone, bills afterwards, never asks how it happened.
talkingPoints: Sit. Whatever you came in with, it's worse than you think.
I stock what keeps people alive out here. It isn't cheap and it isn't optional.
rumours: The glacier colony sends someone for medical supplies. Never the same person twice.

npcs.name: Yerin Solt
npcs.blurb: Lost two fingers to the ice last month and is already arguing about going back out.

dossier.look: Bandaged hand, borrowed clothes, sitting on the edge of the bed rather than in it.
dossier.personality: Restless, embarrassed to be here, and grateful in a way he cannot say out loud.
dossier.voice: Rough and a bit too loud, softening whenever Corrin is in earshot.

talkingPoints: I was eleven hours on the surface. Corrin got there in nine.
Whatever's under the Bonefield, it's warm. That's why the ice gave.
rumours: The meltwater at Kettle Hollow runs warm now. Ice doesn't do that on its own.

npcs.name: Nim Adeyemi
npcs.blurb: Two months into a posting she chose and is still, just about, glad she chose.

dossier.look: Young, braids tied back, sleeves permanently pushed up, moving quickly at all times.
dossier.personality: Eager, competent past her experience, and quietly terrified of the day Corrin is not here.
dossier.voice: Bright and fast, with a habit of narrating what she is doing to whoever is nearest.

talkingPoints: Cold injury, crush injury, decompression. That is the whole list. Over and over.
If you are going under the ice, take a warm pack each. I am not asking.
rumours: Two yard cutters came in from the underhang. Only their gear came back.

locations.name: Pad Three
locations.blurb: Where the Gull is standing. Fuel lines, ice-melt gantries, and the way back off this rock.

interior.artSubject: a starship landing pad cut into ice, open to the sky

chatter: Lines are cold. Give it a minute.

npcs.name: Grig Tallow
npcs.blurb: Enormous coat, tiny voice. Pumps reaction mass and cracks ring-ice into water.
talkingPoints: Tanks first. Everything else on this moon is optional.
I can crack you water out of the ring ice. Takes a day. Costs less than you'd think.
rumours: Ships come in dark sometimes and don't log. I don't ask and neither should you.

npcs.name: Bex Hallow
npcs.blurb: Decides who lands, who waits, and who is turned back into the weather.

dossier.look: High-vis over thermals, headset permanently on, clipboard she never actually reads.
dossier.personality: Brisk and fair, with zero tolerance for pilots who argue with physics.
dossier.voice: Loud over the wind, dry when it drops. Swears like the weather is personally at fault.

talkingPoints: Your ship's on my pad, so your ship's my problem. Let's keep it a small problem.
Nothing lands in a ring squall. Nothing. I don't care what you're carrying.
rumours: Something burned through the upper ring two nights back and didn't answer hail.

npcs.name: Ruaridh Kane
npcs.blurb: Grounded three weeks waiting on a part that Pell keeps promising is nearly here.

dossier.look: Flight jacket over a jumper, sitting on a crate, watching everyone else's ship.
dossier.personality: Bored, chatty, and better than he lets on. Would fly anywhere for the right reason.
dossier.voice: Easy and wry, with the fatalism of somebody who has been stranded before.

talkingPoints: Three weeks. On a moon. Ask me how the food is.
You need a second pilot, I'm cheap and I'm here. That's the whole pitch.
rumours: There's an Apostle cutter working this volume. I've seen its burn twice.

locations.name: The Back Shed
locations.blurb: Behind the yard, past the fence line. You would only know it was here if somebody told you.
locations.gmNotes: Reveal once a PC hears about it — Kesh's 'piece in the back', or Merrow's rumour. api.reveal('the-back-shed') from a macro, or the GM cog.

interior.artSubject: a hidden smuggler's back room behind a salvage yard

npcs.name: The Quiet Man
npcs.blurb: Never gives a name. Buys anything, asks nothing, and pays in hard currency.
talkingPoints: You were told where to find me, so I'll assume you were told how this works.
I don't want the story. I want the thing.
rumours: There's a Concord surveyor holed up at Sett with a chart worth more than this moon.

npcs.name: Lin Serrada
npcs.blurb: Sits where she can see the fence line and says almost nothing to anyone who comes through.

dossier.look: Small, still, hood up, hands never visible.
dossier.personality: Watchful and economical. Answers questions with the fewest words that will do.
dossier.voice: Quiet, unhurried, with a flat certainty that makes people stop talking.

talkingPoints: He'll see you. Wait.
Whatever you brought, don't put it on the table until he asks.
rumours: Two Directorate people came through last month. They didn't buy anything.

cities.name: Kettle Hollow
cities.blurb: A colony carved into the body of a glacier, on no registry anywhere. Meltwater runs in channels down the middle of every hall. They did not expect visitors and they are not pleased to have them.

locations.name: The Ice Gate
locations.blurb: A cut in the glacier face, watched by two wardens who would rather you left.

interior.artSubject: a guarded gate cut into the face of a blue glacier, open to the sky
interior.artProps: a heavy barrier across the cut, sandbagged watch posts, floodlights, meltwater channels, boot-tracked snow, stacked supply crates

npcs.name: Warden Hesk
npcs.blurb: Would very much rather you turned around, and will say so once, politely.

dossier.look: Ice-crusted furs over colony plate, a spear-length cutting bar held like a formality.
dossier.personality: Correct and immovable. Not hostile — simply certain that visitors end badly.
dossier.voice: Low and careful, a colony accent that flattens its vowels.

talkingPoints: We are not on a registry. That is not an oversight.
You may enter. You may not go below the hall. Those are separate permissions.
rumours: The last outsiders we let below did not come back up the same.

npcs.name: Warden Tuli
npcs.blurb: Younger, curious about the outside, and trying hard not to show it.

dossier.look: Furs a size too large, colony brand at the temple, eyes constantly on the visitors' gear.
dossier.personality: Openly fascinated by anything off-world, then embarrassed about being fascinated.
dossier.voice: Quick and slightly too eager, dropping back to formality when Hesk looks over.

talkingPoints: Is it true there are places with no ice at all? Anywhere?
Hesk says outsiders bring the cold in with them. I do not think that is how cold works.
rumours: The Keeper has not been down to the cuts since the meltwater turned warm.

locations.name: The Hollow Hall
locations.lockedReason: The wardens will not let you past the gate
locations.blurb: The colony's common hall, blue-lit through forty metres of ice.

interior.artSubject: the common hall of a colony carved into glacier ice
interior.artProps: long trestle tables and benches, a cooking range along the counter, hanging lamps, meltwater channels running down the middle of the floor, blue ice walls, stacked bedrolls and crates

npcs.name: The Hollow's Keeper
npcs.blurb: Speaks for a colony that is on no registry anywhere, and intends to keep it that way.

dossier.look: Ageless, pale from a life under forty metres of ice, a staff of cut hull-metal.
dossier.personality: Grave, hospitable, and absolutely unyielding about the colony's privacy. Carries the weight of a decision nobody else knows was made.
dossier.voice: Slow and formal, choosing every word, with long silences that are not invitations.

talkingPoints: We did not expect visitors and we are not pleased to have them. Sit anyway.
There are cuts below this hall. We closed them. I will tell you why if you agree to go.
What is down there was here before the ice. We only found it.
rumours: The meltwater runs warm from below. It has done since we stopped digging.

quests.summary: The colony cut down through the glacier for years and then stopped. The Keeper closed the lower cuts, lost two people doing it, and has told nobody outside the Hollow why. The meltwater from below still runs warm.
quests.opening: We closed the cuts beneath this hall and I have not explained that to anyone who was not born here. I am about to explain it to you, and then I am going to ask you to go down.

reward.note: The Hollow opens its gate to you permanently — and its stores.

npcs.name: Brann Ivory
npcs.blurb: Feeds ninety people from what the ice and passing ships will give up.

dossier.look: Broad, scalded forearms, an apron that has seen a decade of service.
dossier.personality: Warm, gossipy, and the only person in the Hollow who will tell an outsider anything.
dossier.voice: Cheerful and constant, talking while working and rarely waiting for answers.

talkingPoints: Eat. You have come a long way and you look it.
The Keeper will not speak of the cuts. I will, if you are eating my food.
rumours: Sefa's crews found a door down there. Not carved. Made.

npcs.name: Sefa Lund
npcs.blurb: Ran the crews that opened the lower cuts, and has not sent anyone down since.

dossier.look: Rope-scarred hands, cutting harness still worn out of habit, never quite still.
dossier.personality: Guilt-ridden and defensive. Wants somebody else to go down and confirm what she saw.
dossier.voice: Terse, then suddenly far too much detail, then terse again.

talkingPoints: I took eleven people down. I brought back nine. Ask the Keeper about the other two.
The walls are not ice all the way down. That is all I will say standing up.
rumours: It is warmer the deeper you go. That is backwards. That is the whole problem.
